CustomField.description: Planned maintenance price band from the unit's tonnage. Keep in step with RLM_HVAC_CommercialPricing.bandSku.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(RLM_HVAC_Tonnage__c), "", IF(RLM_HVAC_Tonnage__c <= 5, "Up to 5 tons", IF(RLM_HVAC_Tonnage__c <= 12, "6 to 12 tons", IF(RLM_HVAC_Tonnage__c <= 25, "13 to 25 tons", "Over 25 tons"))))
CustomField.label: Tonnage Band
